covered.rule: Security order 1-3: member_birthdate (date, MDY), member_pin (6 digits), postal_token (text)
Wrong answers: two globally, counted locally by agent code; no remaining-attempts property
Explain purpose once; second refusal closes aq-unverified/aq-r-declined
Merely asking why we need security is not refusal
Exhausted wrong answers close aq-unverified/aq-r-failed after "Please contact our member desk."
Callback: today only, 12:20-18:10 inclusive, strictly later than now
Band 1-6: fifth business day strictly after today; full by week-end, then floor by deadline
Band 7-20: today+9 calendar days, preceding; one full-by-deadline offer, floor if full refused
Band 21-50: fixed 2026-11-21, preceding; one full-by-deadline offer, floor if full refused
Full first, never ask how much, floor once, "The unpaid remainder stays overdue.", accept floor..full
Today allowed if business day; roll forward; cap at deadline; vague date ask once
Do not silently assume missing date components
Batch confirmation "May I save this arrangement?"; one promise per product
State products before asking; attempt counters per product; common date capped per product
Transfer overrides result; saved promises survive; no notes on transfer
aq-promised / aq-paid / aq-none with first non-paid product's reason; aq-r-service; aq-r-refused; goodbye before close
Hardship: sympathy sentence, offer aq-care-desk, aq-routed/aq-r-care, declined aq-none/aq-r-distress, no promise
Refusal to talk: ask once, then aq-none/aq-r-refused
Exact language table (opening ... recorded_promise_change_reply), opening verbatim
Spoken names flexible credit / term advance
